name: beta_nbin_fit
expr: fb = betafit(xb); err_a = abs(fb(1) - 2.0); err_b = abs(fb(2) - 5.0); fn = nbinfit(xn); err_r = abs(fn(1) - 3.0); err_p = abs(fn(2) - 0.4);
comment: Sig: [ahat, bhat] = betafit(x) — Beta MLE via 2-D Newton on the digamma system. [rhat, phat] = nbinfit(x) — negative binomial MLE: profile log-likelihood, Newton on r with closed-form p = r / (r + mean). Stochastic samples in setup; fingerprint pins recoverability + output shapes.
